item.title: Lawsuit alleges inhumane conditions at Adelanto ICE facility
item.description: The lawsuit alleges people detained in the Adelanto facility lack drinkable water, healthy food, clean clothes, places to sleep and access to medical care. The post Lawsuit alleges inhumane conditions at Adelanto ICE facility appeared first on Long Beach Post.

item.title: Cambodian genocide survivor detained by ICE
item.description: Sithy Yi was detained despite a pending visa application. She’s one of potentially hundreds of crime and human trafficking victims impacted by policy changes, attorneys say The post Cambodian genocide survivor detained by ICE appeared first on Long Beach Post.

item.title: California Democrats have new plans for confronting ICE: Taxes, lawsuits and location bans
item.description: The California Senate passed a bill that would make it easier to sue federal officers over civil rights violations. Recent shootings of civilians by immigration agents in Minnesota lent urgency to the measure, one of several targeting ICE. The post California Democrats have new plans for confronting ICE: Taxes, lawsuits and location bans appeared first on Long Beach Post.

item.title: New CSULB president selected, will start in May
item.description: Loren J. Blanchard, the current president of the University of Houston-Downtown, will succeed Andrew Jones, who served as acting president after Jane Close Conoley retired last summer. The post New CSULB president selected, will start in May appeared first on Long Beach Post.

item.title: Stabbing sparks brief standoff, large police response in downtown

item.title: FIFA planners say Long Beach is not a World Cup Fan Zone as mayor promised it was
item.description: A watch party announced at the State of the City will be an unofficial ‘celebration,’ not a branded partnership with the tournament's organizers. The post FIFA planners say Long Beach is not a World Cup Fan Zone as mayor promised it was appeared first on Long Beach Post.
